name: MemOS
use_label: Give an AI agent long-term memory
one_liner: A memory layer for LLM agents that unifies storing, retrieving and managing long-term memory.

text.why: An agent forgets once the window closes. MemOS is the layer that stores that memory and pulls it back when needed, handling knowledge bases, multi-modal material and tool memory through the same interface.
text.take: This is not a finished app but a layer you put underneath other AI tools, so the value lands with developers fixing the "my agent keeps forgetting" problem.
build: Apache-2.0, exposing one unified API for store, retrieve and manage. Connected to DeepSeek Harness it adds automatic recall, background capture, hybrid retrieval and a local Memory Viewer.

who.role: Developers building agents or support bots, and teams that need internal material remembered and queried.

start.text: Read the getting-started guide at memos.openmem.net and follow the example that wires it into an agent you already run.

caveat: A developer-facing component — not something you install and use as a finished app.

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: The MemOS page showing a diagram of how memories are stored and recalled.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
